products.name: Seesaw
products.note: Found in the research for The AI Ready School; not independently verified. AI: AI translation features reported. Use: Student portfolios and family communication. Who: Teachers, students, families. Student age: Not verified. Privacy: Not verified. Price: Free plan; Seesaw Plus reported at $120 per teacher per year; district plans per student (low-quality secondary source). Caution: Needs official confirmation.

reading.body:
Seesaw is an education platform with over 25 million users where AI is a feature inside a teacher-controlled workflow, not the product itself.

The pattern here is AI embedded in an existing tool rather than sold on its own. Seesaw's site describes teacher-led AI that helps create and adapt activities while teachers stay in control of instruction. That is a different posture from a standalone AI tutor or chatbot, and it puts the AI in the preparation layer, not the delivery layer.

For AI scaling, this matters less than it might appear. The data covers a software product, its stated user count, and reported pricing. It contains nothing about the compute Seesaw runs on, the data centers behind it, or its power draw. A platform serving 25 million users implies real infrastructure, but the data does not say what kind or how much, so no conclusion about grid demand can be drawn from it.

What the data does not establish is equally important. Student age range and privacy practices are unverified. The pricing, including Seesaw Plus at $120 per teacher per year and per-student district plans, comes from a secondary source and needs official confirmation. The AI translation feature is reported rather than confirmed. Treat the user count as the company's own claim and the rest as provisional.
